title: 集合运算
objective: 合并结果集并掌握去重、交集与差集。

knowledgePoints.title: UNION 与 UNION ALL
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：合并不同期间客户记录
knowledgePoints.concept: UNION 合并并去重，UNION ALL 保留所有行及重复项；两侧必须具有相同列数。
knowledgePoints.syntax: SELECT col FROM a UNION [ALL] SELECT col FROM b ORDER BY col;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers UNION ALL SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers UNION ALL SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_id;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 合并不同期间客户记录
knowledgePoints.comparison: JOIN 横向组合列，UNION 纵向组合行。

commonError.example: UNION ALL 后把行数解释为唯一客户数

knowledgePoints.notes: 列名通常取第一查询；类型应语义一致，MySQL 与 SQLite 的隐式类型不同。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 合并两批客户记录时，先区分要保留来源重复还是只要客户清单。
teaching.codeExplanation: UNION ALL 保留重叠，UNION 对整行做去重。参与合并的列要同序、同含义；最终排序写在最后。
teaching.resultExplanation: 同一编号在两边出现时，本例保留两行。若要模拟双侧保留的对账，将匹配和单侧未匹配拆开后用 UNION ALL 拼接。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 两批名单合并后如需唯一客户，先只输出 customer_id 再用 UNION。加入来源标签后，同一客户的两行整行不同，仍会保留；若同时要来源及唯一客户，先明确去重键再汇总来源。

mergeExamples.label: 合并成不重复的客户清单
mergeExamples.explanation: UNION 忽略这批数据的来源，仅对客户编号去重。同一个编号在两批都出现时只返回一次。
mergeExamples.sql:
SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers
UNION
SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers
ORDER BY customer_id;

knowledgePoints.title: 交集、差集与排序
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：识别两期都购买的客户
knowledgePoints.concept: MySQL 8.4 支持 INTERSECT 求交集，EXCEPT 求前一集合减后一集合，默认去重。
knowledgePoints.syntax: SELECT col FROM a INTERSECT SELECT col FROM b; SELECT col FROM a EXCEPT SELECT col FROM b;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_id;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 识别两期都购买的客户
knowledgePoints.comparison: EXCEPT 的顺序有意义；INTERSECT 对称。

commonError.example: SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers 期待共同客户

knowledgePoints.notes: MySQL 支持 ALL 形式而 SQLite 不支持 INTERSECT ALL / EXCEPT ALL；混合运算优先级亦不同。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 比较两个时期或来源的客户集合。
teaching.codeExplanation: INTERSECT 返回双方都存在的编号，EXCEPT 返回仅左侧存在的编号；也可用 EXISTS 或 NOT EXISTS 按键表达。集合结果的整体 ORDER BY 写在最后；需要先限制某个输入集时，用子查询封装该分支。
teaching.resultExplanation: 共有客户为 2 和 3；互换 EXCEPT 两侧会改变结果。核对客户迁入迁出时分别运行两个方向。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 把旧名单放在 EXCEPT 左侧可找流失，互换两侧可找新增。ORDER BY 放在整个差集末尾，只对最后输出排序；先取某批的前 N 条时，需要把该批先封装成子查询。

mergeExamples.label: 找出旧名单里后来消失的客户
mergeExamples.explanation: 旧名单放在左边，结果只包含旧有而新无的编号。反过来写得到新增客户。
mergeExamples.sql:
SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers
EXCEPT
SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers
ORDER BY customer_id;

summary: 完成本章后：合并结果集并掌握去重、交集与差集。
